beliefs: Only the first character of a string is transformed; the rest is copied unchanged (abc→cbc, bcd→dcd, bcdz→dcdz, xyz→zyz, zoo→boo, cat→eat, dog→fog, Hello→Jello) [E3, E4, E5]
Lowercase vowels are shifted forward by 2 (a→c, e→g, i→k, o→q, u→w) [E2, E4]
Lowercase consonants are shifted forward by 2 as well (b→d, c→e, d→f, z→b, x→z, h→j, t→v) [E2, E3, E5]
Uppercase letters are shifted forward by 2 (H→J, Z→B, A→C) [E1, E3, E4]
Digits, punctuation, and spaces are left unchanged [E1, E4, E5]
The first-character rule applies regardless of case: first char shifted by 2, remaining chars verbatim [E3, E4, E5]
notes: E5 showed bcd→dcd, so lowercase consonants shift by +2, not +1; the vowel/consonant distinction was wrong. Unified rule: first character shifted +2 (letters only), rest unchanged.
